title: Question: When will Pull Requests be enabled for external contributors?
body:
Hi! 

I noticed a broken link in and fixed in the root documentation.

I have fixed this on my fork and would love to submit a Pull Request for it, as this will be my very first open-source PR! However, I noticed that Pull Requests are currently restricted to repository collaborators. 

Could you please let me know when PRs will be enabled for external contributors so I can submit it? 

Thank you!
author: HARSHRAO729
